models.author: Mridankan Mandal
models.description:
This is the part 2 (two) of Series E is a controlled fusion-analysis suite on a fixed DINOv3 backbone. It is designed to isolate fusion mechanism effects and metadata interactions with minimal backbone confounding, and is the most direct set for studying performance differences between local and global cross-view modules.

### Included models:
- E5: DINOv3-L plus 2x FullMamba without metadata.
- E6: DINOv3-L plus 1x GatedDepthwiseConv without metadata.
- E7: DINOv3-L plus 4x GatedDepthwiseConv without metadata.
- E8: DINOv3-L plus Identity fusion with metadata.

### Why this series matters:
- It offers controlled evidence on fusion-depth and fusion-type behavior.
- It supports analysis of local versus global fusion under scarce data.
- It captures metadata interaction effects in paired fusion settings.

### Recommended use:
- Use Series E for mechanism focused ablations and architectural diagnostics.
- Use Series E to validate whether a new fusion idea beats strong local baselines.
- Use Series E when studying stability performance trade offs at fixed backbone scale.

### References:
- Research paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.07819
- Official codebase: https://github.com/WhiteMetagross/FusionComplexityInversionBiomass
- CSIRO competition dataset: https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/csiro-biomass/data

# Example Use

## Title
ISIC Skin Lesion Classification – ${num_classes} Classes (${backbone} + ${head} + ${metadata})

## Description
Este modelo fue entrenado sobre el dataset **${dataset}** para la clasificación de lesiones cutáneas en **${num_classes} clases clínicas**.  
La arquitectura combina un **backbone ${backbone}** con un **módulo ${head}**, e incorpora **${metadata}** como entrada adicional.

- **Dataset:** ${dataset}
- **Clases:** ${class_names}
- **Backbone:** ${backbone}
- **Head:** ${head}
- **Metadata:** ${metadata}
- **Entrenamiento:** ${optimizer}, ${loss}, ${scheduler}
- **Métrica principal:** ${main_metric}

## Usage
```
python
import torch
from my_model import ResNet50AttentionCapsNetWithMetadata

model = ResNet50AttentionCapsNetWithMetadata(
    num_classes=${num_classes},
    metadata_dim=${metadata_dim},
    num_routing=${routing_iterations},
    pretrained=False,
    dropout_p=0.4
)

model.load_state_dict(torch.load("/kaggle/input/${model_name}/best_model_state.pth", map_location="cuda"))
model.eval()
```
